services.name: Tasting Passport
services.desc: Indulge in Oregon's Willamette Valley Wine Country with our exclusive tasting passport at The Vintages, featuring complimentary tastings, enticing 2-for-1 offers, and unbeatable discounts on wine bottles at select local wineries and tasting rooms. (retail value: $325) Discover the rich flavors and scenic landscapes of our renowned wine region-all included with your stay. Book now for an unforgettable Oregon Wine Country experience. services.name: 1999 Airstream Safari
services.desc: The 1999 Safari is one of our silver beauties. While its exterior is a vintage classic, its interior boasts a more modern appeal - the best of both worlds. It comes complete with a full size bed, spacious dining area perfect for board games galore, private bathroom with a shower and toilet, and everything else you might need for a fun glamping getaway. Cancellation: Cancellations must be made by 4:00 pm five days prior to arrival to avoid a penalty equal to one night plus taxes.Taxes & Cleaning Fee: In addition to your trailer rate, there is a small state lodging tax, local city tax, and a $45 one-time cleaning fee.Furry Friends: A maximum of two dogs are permitted per pet-friendly Shasta
